newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Net sales of Philippine leading sectors up 7.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Net sales of Philippine leading sectors up 7.0 pct.

text.p: Sales of top 21 sectors in the Philippines rose by an average of 7.0 percent in the first eight months of the year, a survey conducted by the trade and industry department released on Monday said.
"On sectoral level, 12 sectors experienced positive sales value growth rates within the range of 3 percent to 26 percent during the survey period," the report said.
Leading the biggest gainers were the electronic sector which went up by 26 percent, cement firms, up by 22 percent, pharmaceuticals, 14 percent, and food processing, 13 percent.
The biggest loser was the sugar industry, whose sales slipped 38 percent from last year's level.
Other losers were the agro-based industry which went down by 19 percent, metallic mining which slid by 18 percent, and iron and steel firms, 15 percent.
